items.title: 구찌, 연말 가격 또 올렸다…마몽 미니백 9.5% '조용히' 인상
items.summary: Report that Gucci quietly raised prices on multiple leather goods and footwear lines (effective late October) without formal notice: GG Marmont mini bag up 9.5%, Marmont bag category up as much as 17.5%, loafers up 5.7-6.1%, Ancora sneakers up 14.5%, leather sandals up 12.5%. Framed as part of a pattern of unannounced, recurring year-end price hikes drawing consumer criticism. Critical-angle item (published a year prior to this cycle but still actively recirculating in Korean consumer-pricing discourse; kept because it directly documents the recurring 'quiet price hike' pattern still being cited in Nov 2026 coverage).

items.title: 잘나가던 명품 주춤…백화점 매출 증가율 40%→10%대 '뚝'
items.summary: Korean department-store luxury sales growth slowed from roughly 40% in Q2 2026 to the 10% range by October, with jewelry growth falling from 65-80.9% to 15-20.7%. Gucci's Q3 comparable sales fell 6% year-on-year group-wide, cited alongside LVMH's 5% fashion/leather decline as evidence of a broader luxury pullback; the piece also notes resale-market softening (Hermès Birkin resale multiple down from 2.6x to 1.7x retail) and brands reversing earlier price hikes. Critical-angle item.

items.title: Kering, 구찌 매출 6% 감소에도 3분기 매출 예상치 부합
items.summary: Kering Q3 group revenue of EUR3.35bn matched forecasts despite a 1% comparable decline; Gucci revenue fell to EUR1.29bn (-4% reported, -6% comparable), with retail sales comparable down 9%, pressured by lower visitor traffic in mainland China, wider Asia-Pacific and Japan. North America was Gucci's strongest region. CEO Luca de Meo called Gucci's recovery the group's top priority. Critical/earnings-angle item still being referenced in mid-November Korean financial commentary.

items.title: 11四半期連続マイナス、100店舗閉鎖＿いまグッチに何が起きているのか？

Critical/analytical community-channel item.
